title: UneceInstalmentPayment
description:
A discharge of obligations in respect of funds or securities, transferred through one of several payments, between two
or more parties.

dueDateTime.description: The due date for this instalment payment.

paidAmount.description: A monetary value paid or to be paid for this instalment payment.

sequenceId.description: The sequence identifier for this instalment payment.

specifiedFinancingRequestResultDocument.description: The financing request result document specified for this instalment payment.
